what: Independent rerun of every repository check on the final v0.4 source tree, from a separate checkout with the custom-module build cache removed. Mathlib was taken from the pinned cache, not rebuilt. check.sh was run twice per declaration: the repository copy and a byte-identical copy at the checkout root.
machine: 18-core Apple silicon, LEAN_NUM_THREADS 6 for the build and 2 for every check; 3 oracle workers and 4 replay workers in parallel, so per-item wall times are inflated
